IPC.open: Returns a pair of connected `IPCPort`s for constructing the IPC duplex stream based on `bare-pipe`. Each port is transferable and can be sent to another thread or process before being connected.
IPC: Returns a duplex stream using the provided `port`. See `bare-stream`'s `Duplex` (<https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-stream>) for the duplex stream API.
IPC.incoming: The underlying `bare-pipe` `Pipe` used for reading. Read-only.
IPC.outgoing: The underlying `bare-pipe` `Pipe` used for writing. Read-only.
IPCPort.incoming: The file handle used for reading. Read-only.
IPCPort.outgoing: The file handle used for writing. Read-only.
ref: Increase the reference count for the IPC to keep the event loop alive.
unref: Decrease the reference count for the IPC to allow the event loop to exit.
IPCPort: Constructs a port from a pair of file handles, `incoming` and `outgoing`.
connect: Returns an `IPC` connected to the `port` and marks the `port` as detached.
detached: A boolean for whether the `port` is detached. A port becomes detached once it is connected or transferred, and a detached port cannot be transferred again.
